nodes.name: checkhash.sh
nodes.summary: Verifies a file's SHA-256 against an expected hash and, in learn mode, appends the corrected substitution to a file instead of failing.

nodes.name: hash.sh
nodes.summary: Portable wrapper that prints only the SHA-256 hex digest of a file using shasum on macOS and sha256sum elsewhere.

nodes.name: lock.sh
nodes.summary: Locks a target file while a tool download is in progress, using flock when available and a temporary file plus trap to publish only complete downloads.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses bash exec redirection to hold a file descriptor lock; silently degrades on macOS where flock is absent.

nodes.name: finish
nodes.summary: EXIT/SIGINT trap that atomically renames the temporary download into place on success, removes partial files on failure, and releases the lock file.
